headline: The top 5 land before Go Big; Brain follows
annotation: Data-engineering capacity for P1 must be booked in December; it is the critical path.
source: Source: P&I plan; dates depend on partner-team capacity.
notes: Everything in the top 5 lands before Go Big on 1 February. Pilot learnings in December feed the Go Big segments in January.

After Go Big, the Finance report runs monthly on the new definitions, and Brain v1 starts in FIT+ with rules from the Go Big segments, then moves to George once Vienna capacity is secured. A small persona pilot runs in March and April, validated against real campaign results.
The critical path is data-engineering capacity for the metric truth. That is my first ask.
